title: LibScript Application & Stack Manifest
description: Declarative manifest schema for full-stack application dependencies, databases, services, lifecycle hooks, ingress, and cloud infrastructure.

aliases.description: Alternative CLI selector names or identifiers for targeting this application in multi-app stacks.

items.description: Alias string matching --only selectors.

version.description: Semantic version of the application or stack manifest

domain.description: Primary domain name for ingress routing and DNS mapping

secrets.description: Directory path or Vault/OpenBao URL for storing and retrieving generated secrets

secrets_dir.description: Relative directory containing secret files transferred out-of-band during cloud deployment

env.description: Global environment variables and colon-separated multi-host search path defaults injected across manifest operations

^[A-Z0-9_]+$.description: Environment variable string value or fallback expression

remote_env.description: Remote-node environment variable overrides or multi-host search path defaults normalized when syncing .env during cloud deployment

^[A-Z0-9_]+$.description: Remote environment variable string value or fallback expression

deps.description: Map of required LibScript component names to version strings or configuration objects

^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$.description: Requested semantic version string or dependency override specification

databases.description: Declarative database and cache instances to initialize, seed, and verify during health checks

items.description: Single database provisioning and health verification specification

engine.description: Database engine identifier (postgres, postgresql, mysql, mariadb, sqlite, sqlite3, duckdb, valkey, redis)

user.description: Database role or system owner user

password.description: Database password (prefer password_env for sensitive credentials)

password_env.description: Environment variable name from which to read the database password

path.description: Filesystem path for file-backed databases such as DuckDB or SQLite

db_path.description: Alias for filesystem path of file-backed databases

extra_paths.description: Additional database or session files whose ownership and permissions should be aligned with the database user

items.description: Filesystem path or environment variable expression for an auxiliary database file

url_env.description: Environment variable name exported with the constructed connection URI (defaults to DATABASE_URL)

min_tables.description: Minimum number of user tables required in the database for health checks to pass

required_tables.description: Array of table names that must exist and have non-zero row counts (or >= min_rows)

items.description: Table name required to exist in the database

min_rows.description: Minimum row count required for each table in required_tables (integer or table-to-count map)

additionalProperties.description: Minimum row count required for the named table

seed_file.description: Relative or absolute path to a SQL seed script executed during provisioning

seed_dir.description: Directory of SQL, CSV, or Parquet files imported during provisioning

migration_dir.description: Directory of SQL migration files applied in order during provisioning

seed_command.description: Custom shell command executed in the manifest directory to seed the database

health_command.description: Custom shell command executed during health checks to verify database integrity

services.description: Declarative application service daemons managed by LibScript

items.description: Service daemon runtime and health check specification

command.description: Command executed to start the service daemon

working_dir.description: Working directory for the service process relative to the manifest directory

user.description: System user account under which the service runs

port.description: TCP port exposed by the service for fallback readiness checks

env.description: Environment variables injected into the service runtime

env_files.description: List of dotenv files loaded prior to starting the service

items.description: Path to a dotenv file

health_check.description: Deep health check configuration supporting command execution, HTTP polling, and JSON payload assertions

url.description: HTTP/HTTPS endpoint URL polled during service health verification

command.description: Shell command executed inside the service working directory to verify health

expect_status.description: Expected HTTP response status code (defaults to 200)

expect_json.description: jq filter expression that must evaluate to true against the HTTP JSON response body

retries.description: Maximum number of HTTP polling retries before failing the health check

interval.description: Interval in seconds between HTTP health check retries

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for each HTTP health check request

healthcheck.description: Alias for health_check supporting identical command, URL, and expect_json properties

production_command.description: Production command executed to start the service daemon when LIBSCRIPT_ENV is not development

dev_command.description: Development command executed to start the service daemon when LIBSCRIPT_ENV is development

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks executed during installation, build, migration, seeding, service transitions, and health checks

pre_install.description: Hooks executed prior to dependency installation

items.description: Hook command string or structured hook object

post_install.description: Hooks executed after dependency installation completes

items.description: Hook command string or structured hook object

build.description: Hooks executed to compile or bundle application assets before service startup

items.description: Hook command string or structured hook object

db_migrate.description: Hooks executed after database provisioning to apply schema migrations and seeds

items.description: Hook command string or structured hook object

seed.description: Hooks executed to populate initial or synthetic datasets

items.description: Hook command string or structured hook object

pre_start.description: Hooks executed immediately before starting application service daemons

items.description: Hook command string or structured hook object

post_start.description: Hooks executed after application service daemons have started

items.description: Hook command string or structured hook object

pre_stop.description: Hooks executed prior to stopping application service daemons

items.description: Hook command string or structured hook object

post_stop.description: Hooks executed after application service daemons have stopped

items.description: Hook command string or structured hook object

health.description: Hooks executed during 'libscript health' to run project-specific health assertions

items.description: Hook command string or structured hook object

init_system.description: Preferred service supervision system (auto, systemd, openrc, sysvinit, bsd_rc, launchd, smf, runit, s6, sc, fallback).

service_overrides.description: Declarative environment variable overrides keyed by system daemon name (e.g., ollama).

additionalProperties.description: Environment variable key-value map for the target system service.

applications.description: List of child application manifests deployed onto a shared node or stack topology.

items.description: Child application deployment target specification.

path.description: Local repository or manifest directory path.

remote_dest.description: Remote destination directory name on the target node.

domain.description: Public domain name routed to this application.

frontends.description: Declarative frontend, SPA, MFE, and Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) build and webroot staging specifications.

items.description: Single frontend or SPA compilation and staging configuration.

id.description: Unique frontend identifier used for staging webroot subdirectories.

framework.description: Frontend build framework identifier (e.g., angular, vite, react, vue, kmp).

working_dir.description: Working directory of the frontend project relative to the manifest directory.

source_dir.description: Alias for working_dir specifying the frontend source directory.

package_manager.description: Node.js package manager used for dependency installation (npm, pnpm, yarn, bun).

install_command.description: Custom command executed to install frontend dependencies inside working_dir.

build_command.description: Custom command executed to compile production frontend assets (e.g., npx ng build, npm run build, npx vite build).

output_dir.description: Compiled asset output directory relative to working_dir or the manifest directory.

artifact_check.description: Path to a compiled output artifact (such as index.html) verified for idempotent build reuse.

stage_dir.description: Target directory where compiled frontend assets are staged for static serving.

clean_dirs.description: Directories cleaned inside working_dir when --force-rebuild is requested.

items.description: Relative directory path to remove before rebuilding.

env.description: Environment variables exported during frontend dependency installation and compilation.

ingress.description: Reverse-proxy, SPA, and WebSocket ingress configuration applied via netctl.

provider.description: Reverse-proxy engine used to serve the ingress configuration.

engine.description: Alias for provider specifying the reverse-proxy engine.

server_name.description: Alias for domain specifying the virtual host server_name.

tls.description: TLS certificate provisioning strategy ('letsencrypt' acquires and persists read-only CA certificates in cert_store_dir; 'self-signed' generates a local X.509 certificate).

port.description: Primary HTTP/HTTPS listen port for the ingress virtual host.

expect_html.description: Substring expected in the public ingress HTML response during health verification.

cert_store_dir.description: Persistent read-only directory on attached storage for storing Let's Encrypt certificates across VM recreations (defaults to /mnt/data/certs).

acme_webroot.description: Filesystem webroot directory served under /.well-known/acme-challenge/ for Let's Encrypt HTTP-01 validation.

email.description: Contact email address for Let's Encrypt ACME account registration.

renew_before_seconds.description: Remaining certificate validity threshold in seconds passed to openssl x509 -checkend before renewing (0 = renew only when expired).

proxy_send_timeout.description: Upstream proxy send timeout in seconds (e.g., 300 or '300s').

proxy_read_timeout.description: Upstream proxy read timeout in seconds for long-running LLM/SSE endpoints (e.g., 300 or '300s').

proxy_buffering.description: Whether upstream proxy response buffering is enabled ('on'/'off' or boolean).

listen.description: Port or list of ports to listen on.

items.description: TCP listen port.

routes.description: Routing table mapping URL prefixes to upstream proxies, WebSockets, or static/SPA directories.

items.description: Single ingress route entry.

target.description: Upstream URL or local filesystem path.

experiments.description: Declarative empirical benchmark suite specification(s) conforming to experiment-suite.schema.json.

items.description: Single empirical experiment suite manifest.
